about: A migration run at 'verifying' crashes; recover runs once and works: it undoes both units and waits for flags-1. The Edit guard never writes flags-1, so the writer types abandon. `abandon` at 16:55: Never checked says "Markup wasn't checked after the run's last edit." Every unit is undone, so Copies still in your notes is left out; there's no typed request, so Your request is left out. Other notes names the snapshot folder. The notes stay as recover left them.
readings: Abandon runs after any recover, not only a failed one: it needs only `recover_tried` (09.3 item 1). A recover that worked, followed by an Edit guard that never writes its flags file, is the stuck run 09.2 item 6 names.
